correctness.rationale: The Farey reduction, three central interval families, strict explicit witnesses in every competing family, and separate coprimality obstruction at the exceptional endpoint are proved in RESULT.md. Wang–Xie–Zhao Section 5 gives the uniform n>=5504798 exclusion of off-center cases; van Doorn Section 2 gives exact counts at the surviving endpoints. verify.py checked 220 central interval counts and 32 independently enumerated Farey orders. These finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof. Residual mathematical dependency: the published uniform analytic bound is used without independent reconstruction.

value.rationale: Uniqueness is the next natural extremal invariant after exact f(n), explicitly motivated by van Doorn’s proposed classification of near-minimizers. The theorem identifies exact endpoint coordinates of the sole extremal pair in each of four infinite residue classes and rules out all other ties, unlike a numerical minimum formula. No classification of almost-minimizers or optimal cutoff is asserted.
